```{r setup, include = FALSE}

library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

i_am("PWA.rproj")
```

```{r loading model results}
era5_results <- read_csv(here("raven/Triangular_Routing/CypressRiverT_ERA5_Hydrographs.csv"))
# era5_results <- read_csv(here("raven/Triangular_Routing/output/CypressRiver_Hydrographs.csv"))
era5_storage <- read_csv(here("raven/Triangular_Routing/CypressRiverT_ERA5_WatershedStorage.csv"))
# era5_storage <- read_csv(here("raven/Triangular_Routing/output/CypressRiver_WatershedStorage.csv"))


```

```{r function}
calculate_metrics <- function(results_tibble) {
  metrics <- list(
    r = cor(results_tibble$`sub875 (observed) [m3/s]`, results_tibble$`sub875 [m3/s]`, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    alpha = sd(results_tibble$`sub875 [m3/s]`, na.rm = TRUE) / sd(results_tibble$`sub875 (observed) [m3/s]`, na.rm = TRUE),
    beta = mean(results_tibble$`sub875 [m3/s]`, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(results_tibble$`sub875 (observed) [m3/s]`, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  metrics$KGE <- 1 - sqrt((metrics$r - 1)^2 +
                          (metrics$alpha - 1)^2 +
                          (metrics$beta - 1)^2)
  
  metrics$pbias <- (mean(results_tibble$`sub875 [m3/s]`, na.rm = T)-mean(results_tibble$`sub875 (observed) [m3/s]`, na.rm = T))/mean(results_tibble$`sub875 (observed) [m3/s]`, na.rm = T)
  
  narm_rt <- results_tibble %>% filter(!is.na(`sub875 [m3/s]`) & !is.na(`sub875 (observed) [m3/s]`))
  
  metrics$NSE <- 1 - sum((narm_rt$`sub875 (observed) [m3/s]`- narm_rt$`sub875 [m3/s]`)^2)/sum(narm_rt$`sub875 (observed) [m3/s]`-mean(narm_rt$`sub875 (observed) [m3/s]`)^2)
  
  return(metrics)
}

```

```{r check simulation during missing observation periods}
era5_nowsc <- era5_results %>% 
  filter(is.na(`sub875 (observed) [m3/s]`))

mean(era5_nowsc$`sub875 [m3/s]`)

# check bias assuming na = 0

era5_nafill <- era5_results %>% 
  mutate(`sub875 (observed) [m3/s]` = ifelse(is.na(`sub875 (observed) [m3/s]`), 0, `sub875 (observed) [m3/s]`))



```



```{r model performance metrics}

era5_metrics <- list()

era5_metrics$all <- calculate_metrics(era5_results)

era5_metrics$nafill <- calculate_metrics(era5_nafill)
```



```{r after 2003}
era5_recent <- era5_results %>% 
  filter(year(date)>2002)

era5_metrics$recent <- calculate_metrics(era5_recent)
```


```{r spring in flood years}
era5_flood <- era5_recent %>% 
  filter(month(date) < 7 & year(date) %in% c(2004, 2006, 2009, 2013, 2017))

era5_metrics$flood <- calculate_metrics(era5_flood)
```
